summary: Comprehensive testing of booking flow (public + ops). Backend APIs working well (93.3% success, 56/60 tests). CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: /booking page completely broken with React error preventing any public bookings. ERP booking management works correctly.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 422 instead of 400 for validation errors (name/phone missing)
minor_issues.impact: Minor - 422 is actually more appropriate for validation errors than 400

rbac_issues.issue: Marketing admin can access bookings endpoint (should be 403)
rbac_issues.impact: RBAC violation - marketing should not see booking data

rbac_issues.issue: Marketing admin gets 404 on media endpoint (should be 200)
rbac_issues.impact: Marketing cannot access media library as intended

critical_bugs.issue: Complete page crash with React error: 'Cannot read properties of null (reading origin)'
critical_bugs.root_cause: In BookingWizard.jsx line 74-84, searchPayload callback accesses search.service, search.start, search.origin without optional chaining, but search is initialized as null (line 33). When callback is referenced before loadConfig completes, it tries to access properties on null.
critical_bugs.impact: SHOWSTOPPER - Public booking flow completely broken, no bookings can be made through UI
affected_selectors: All booking form elements not rendering
critical_bugs.fix_suggestion: Add optional chaining in searchPayload callback: search?.service, search?.start, search?.origin, etc. OR ensure callback is not called/referenced until search state is initialized
